scientific_integrity: Proof uses exact two-site resolvent determinant, a reflection-staggering symmetry, and lattice Green threshold and far-field expansions; finite quadrature only corroborates constants.
scientific_limitations: Statement classifies eigenvalues only outside the essential interval [0,12]; embedded eigenvalues and scattering are not addressed.
Near-threshold gap asymptotic assumes a fixed nonzero separation; inverse-square distance asymptotic fixes lattice spacing.
The available broad 2009 three-dimensional impurity study was compared using only its abstract, leaving a residual literature-priority risk.
title: Sharp binding threshold and separation penalty for a neutral pair of cubic-lattice defects
